name: Baseline Measurement

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown: Baseline: the final state of the previous loop (bcdcf81). The alternated run against the opening state d5cb2e1 (docs/changelog/2026-10-16-macos-fast-mode-improvement-loop.md) shows scroll-data-table fast on at 2.94 > 3.54 ms CPU (+21%, draw p50 +7%) and dashboard-one-panel fast on at 2.83 > 3.43 ms (+21%, draw p50 +11%), in all three repetitions.
measurementPlanMarkdown: Reproduce both, bisect by building the kept commits in order, name the change that costs the time, then fix that mechanism alone.
